scope: CGB RGB aperture and fixed-angle bare-panel composition; no replacement-panel imagery or unmeasured cover-lens effect is accepted.
auditRules: A source must distinguish an OEM CGB panel from a modern replacement panel before it can constrain product geometry.
Camera demosaic, resampling, moire, focus blur, surface reflection, and unknown viewing orientation prevent numeric fill-factor extraction unless the raw calibrated capture and scale are available.
Published images remain cited at their original locator; no reduced or re-encoded derivative is substituted for the source.
The HCS spectra and WS1 LUT already collapse the accepted 45 degree illumination and 0 degree normal view; MRS or lens gain cannot be applied again.

retained: HR-TFT uses optimized RGB micro color filters
Super-HA places an aluminum reflective electrode inside the cell
MRS uses numerous randomly aligned projections to diffuse incident light and avoid interference coloration
notRetained: the prototype as the exact CGB panel
numeric CGB subpixel fill, gap, bus mask, notch, or MRS facet geometry

retained: CGB subpixels are described as left-to-right RGB
the microscope observation is described as roughly rectangular
notRetained: GBCC semicircle radius, spacing, color triplets, or 1080p-tuned phase as physical CGB measurements
numeric fill factor from the compressed web image

retained: CGB rendering uses three RGB subpixels
the average output color is explicitly preserved by the prior-art doubler
notRetained: BGB's visual kernel, edge width, overflow rule, interlacing, or color correction as OEM geometry
a second independent numeric fill-factor measurement

retained: fixed D65 45 degree illumination and 0 degree detector color
code-zero black XYZ used only as the declared inactive-region color reference
measurement target had the case and screen glass removed
notRetained: a cover-lens tint, glare strength, BRDF, or alternate angle

decision.selected: minimum-assumption equal-third left-to-right RGB rectangles with activeFill=1 and analytic host-footprint integration
decision.why: CGB-specific and independent prior-art observations agree on three RGB subpixels, while only one source explicitly identifies left-to-right order and no calibrated source supports a numeric inactive gap. Full coverage is therefore the neutral non-invented geometry.
